entries.summary: Foundation: submission envelope schema, Supabase storage (sole writer + in-memory fallback), server-side validation/anti-troll, POST /api/submissions + /api/events, migrations 001/002, 12 passing tests.
Mobile-first React intake form over the submission API: flow, optional fields+freeform, autosave/restore, offline retry queue, contributor prefill, switch-away warning, tap tooltips. 13 tests.
Seed corpus + entity resolution (confirm-then-resolve) + per-aspect coverage model + RAG index + pgvector migrations. 12 tests.
Polish + analytics: Framer Motion transitions, per-section palette, reduced-motion, learn-more page, collapsible info bar, Plausible loader + field_completed. v1 shippable. 16 frontend tests.

AI interview engine (deterministic routing + LLM phrasing), confirm-then-resolve, coverage-routed deflection, guardrails, /api/interview/*, chat UI, eval harness (gates pass). 36 backend + 18 frontend tests.
Durable v2 state: Persistence port (Null/InMemory/Supabase), write-through + hydrate for entities/coverage/sessions, resume across restart, migration 005. 42 backend tests.
react-router-dom scaffold: encyclopedia shell at /, intake relocated to /contribute/*; audit found zero root-path coupling; 4 new regression tests (22/22)
Backend foundation: 006 schema (entries/tags/entry_tags/media), EncyclopediaService facade (Factory/Flyweight/CoR/Strategy, published-gate), read-only /api/entries + /api/search (50 new tests, 92/92)
PRD Feature 1: Layout shell + Home/Section/EntryDetail/404, Template Method sections, Decorator entry blocks, SimilarEntries; 36 new tests (58/58)
PRD Feature 2: /search page, FilterPanel/FilterChips/SearchBar, URL-driven AND/OR filters, measured empty state, header mount at merge; 15 new tests (73/73 combined)

Encyclopedia + Search/Filtering/Discovery shipped: 5 partitions (foundation, routing, browse, search, seo-polish), 92 backend + 107 frontend tests, canon synthesized (5 new ADRs, encyclopedia module snapshot)

Scene foundation merged into initiative/field-view: scene types, field geometry, pure ops, rAF-coalesced store, four built-in presets, SVG field layer, /field-view + /field-view/designer routes. 26 new tests, full suite 133/133 green.

Whiteboard merged into initiative/field-view: tokens.ts, pieceLayer drag (thrower-carries-mark, clamping, keyboard nudge), preset system (registry + PresetMenu with save/rename/delete-undo/export/import), PNG export. 65 new tests, full suite 172/172 green.

Headless space model complete: brief §4 as a pure library (constants/math/layers/score/explain/palette), §8 model checks + FR-3.2 regression as tests, 74 tests, computeGrid ~10 ms; vert preset recalibrated for §8.1 geometry.

Mode 2: versioned PlayFile v1 (client-approved, annotations reserved via drop-unknown-keys forward compat), boundary validation, PlayStore seam, id-paired linear tween, keyframe timeline with transport/retime/reorder/undo, play metadata + JSON import-export, whiteboard->designer scene handoff. 38 new tests; frontend suite 289/289.

Mode 3 UI: model-agnostic canvas painter (built and measured on a synthetic grid first — grid 9.42ms + paint 0.70ms = 10.18ms of a 16ms frame), shared FieldCanvas stage owning the frame loop, overlay rail + tuning panel + imperative hover readout (0 React commits across 25 pointer moves), validated localStorage prefs, ?perf=1 readout. Fixed a PNG-export regression the new canvas layer introduced. space/ untouched, enforced by a git-based guard. 39 new tests; frontend suite 322/322.

Partition 6: written acceptance checklist mapping all nine brief-8 checks to test or manual script, md/xl responsive breakpoints with sub-768 notice, full a11y sweep (axe + keyboard traversal on both routes), perf assertions split into an isolated npm run test:perf. Client visual review deferred past the initiative boundary to a deployed preview by Builder decision.

Field View initiative complete: coaching whiteboard, keyframed play designer, and live strong/weak space heatmap at /field-view. Six partitions, 229 new tests (336 frontend total). Client-only. Canon synthesized: new modules/fieldview.md plus product/tech/ux/summary updates. Client visual review deferred to the deployed site.

Field View UX tweak: nearest-piece picking, focus ring, sizing (pieces 9 -> 7.5), attack-arrow label, present mode, marquee selection, advanced settings rail; /fieldview route rename with legacy redirects; Druk trial fonts removed and replaced with self-hosted Archivo Black (OFL)

fieldview-shell: vertical field orientation, store-based selection model, typed panel registry, three-pane Light Film Room desktop shell, mobile bottom sheet (SmallScreenNotice retired). 6 partitions, 327 fieldview tests green.

fieldview-play-model: possession as stored truth with derived thrower/mark roles, matchups with 1-to-1 swap and free roam, force presets that move the mark (force never stored), play format v2 backfilled on read. 4 partitions, 527 fieldview tests green.
Pure kinematics library: types, constants, vec, accel-limited arrive() with emergent turn cost, waypoint routes, 4-way mutation-tested motionGuard. 49 new tests.
Cushion pursuit model on a reaction delay, step() as single physics entry point, headless simulate() with exact live/headless agreement. 36 new tests.
Fixed-timestep accumulator driving step() off rAF; one store.mutate per rendered frame; run/stop/reset; reduced-motion path; ADR-2 Profiler assertion. 19 new tests.
